notes.title: Challenge Mode & Mod Support Available Now! 15% OFF During Winter Sale!
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers! As the holiday season approaches, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude for the overwhelming support you've shown us since our launch and beyond. In the spirit of festive cheer, we bring you some exciting updates to enhance your Legendary Creatures 2 experience!

[h3]Dungeon crawler enthusiasts, please be sure to check out the brand-new challenge mode:[/h3]

Dive into our brand-new challenge mode featuring faster, more straightforward gameplay. Can you reach and defeat the final boss before your limited chances run out? Test your strategic wits and encounter special facilities to learn skills from other classes and races. With 6 difficulty levels, you'll share current crystals and unlockables simultaneously with the regular game. Feel free to access the challenge mode when starting a new game for an extra dose of excitement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394660/55b8aa48f643217188fc2e10590ad019e29c7512.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394660/c504354c5c66df0545b84dadf83805f60ccbb52c.jpg[/img]


[h3]Modding support is now available![/h3]

We're thrilled to announce that modding support has arrived! Explore the Steam Workshop to find mods that suit your taste, and stay tuned as we prepare the tech files for creating your own mods. Localized files will be shared soon, allowing you to optimize your gaming experience. Join our Discord server to stay updated: https://discord.gg/89XMkfYt2N.

Last but not least, there will be a 15% discount throughout the entire Steam Winter Sale. If you haven't purchased the game already, now would be a great time to join the adventure!

Once again, thank you for your support all along. See you in this fantastic world of Legendary Creatures 2!

notes.title: Update November 26, 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]General Game Adjustments:[/h3]

1. The refresh function at in-game facilities is now unlimited. Reduced the crystal cost for refreshing Emblems.
2. Added refresh function to Battle Academia and Physical Transformation.
3. Mystery will not disappear now.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

1. Fixed an issue where the icon information did not update after upgrading equipment.
2.  Fixed a bug in Sec-fender Stone and Skill-offsetting Stone to ensure their effects work properly.

notes.title: Update November 24, 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]General Game Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Added a new unit - Blacksmith.
2. Removed the Blacksmith Shop from the world map. Now the Blacksmith can join your Troop and help you craft equipment without limitations on attempts.
3. The refresh function at in-game facilities is now unlimited.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

1. Fixed an issue where several Emblems also work for the enemy.
2. Ensured that Tank's skill - Determination functions as intended.
3. Fixed a bug that Elemental Disorder would deal damage to allies.

notes.title: Special mode is coming! Nominate Legendary Creatures 2 for Sit Back And Relax
notes.notes:
Many thanks for your unwavering support! 

We've heard your excitement about modding! Another special mode and modding support are currently in active development and are expected to be unveiled by late December. We appreciate your patience and look forward to sharing these exciting updates with you!

Additionally, it's time for the Steam Awards nominations. If you enjoy playing Legendary Creatures 2, we kindly ask for your vote in the "Sit Back And Relax" category. Your support means a lot to us!

Let us know your thoughts via Discord: https://discord.gg/89XMkfYt2N

notes.title: Update November 17, 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]General Game Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Added a new filtering option that allows you to locate all Towns/Cities/Castles on the map.

2. The DMG Ranking now shows enemy damage and provides detailed information on damage and healing.

3. The DMG Ranking no longer tallies overflow damage.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

1. Fixed a bug in Emblem - Way of Assassination where the DMG Boost was not applying correctly.

2. Fixed a bug in Emblem - Stone Cold where Assassins couldn't gain Berserked when Crit.

3. Fixed an issue that Swashbuckler's Skill - Howling Storm could be triggered by Passive DMG.

4. Fixed an issue where Frost Giant sometimes wasn't immune to Frozen.

5. Fixed an issue where Lava Giant sometimes wasn't immune to Burning.

6. Fixed an issue where consecutive clicks on Dismiss would trigger the action repeatedly.

7. Fixed an issue in the content to unlock with Crystals where the "Leave" button was not displaying correctly.

notes.title: Update November 3, 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]General Game Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Added a new facility, where your unit could learn exclusive skills from other units.

2. Adjusted the emblem - Quick Engagement: Passive DMG no longer triggers this effect.

3. Adjusted Darkblades' skill - Arcane Shield: Passive DMG will no longer be factored in.

4. Adjusted part of the Invisible skills: Increased the stacks of Invisible, while preventing additional stack increases through skill upgrades.

5. Enhanced Reaper's Envoy's exclusive skill - Art of Assassination: Increased the basic DMG from 100% to 150%.

6. Tweaked Swashbuckler's skill - Howling Storm: Decreased the chance to trigger the effect from 50% to 40%.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

1. Fixed the bug that the Emblem - Eternity also works for the enemy Supports.

notes.title: Update October 31, 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]General Game Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Increased the amount of crystals obtained in the game.

2. Added another Battle Academia. (Can't be reused for the same unit.)

3. Adjusted the HP restoration after each battle: Restore 50% of HP lost after a battle with Elite Enemy; Restore 100% of HP lost after a battle with Boss.

4. Enhanced Assassin's skill - Execution: Reduced the CD from 10 to 7.

5. Enhanced Assassin's skill - Assassination: Reduced the CD from 8 to 6.

6. Enhanced Assassin's skill - Phantom Strike: Increased the Physical DMG from 150% to 180%.

7. Adjusted Altai's exclusive skill - Deadly Lurker: Increased the basic DMG and decreased the buff stacks.

8. Adjusted exclusive skill of Reaper's Envoy - Art of Assassination: Now normal Attack will disable half of the stacks.

9. Enhanced Crossbowman's skill - Curve Arrow: Increased the probability of triggering the effect from 30% to 50%.

10. Enhanced the stats of some special Gems that offer DMG Boost and DMG Reduction based on status of the units.

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]

1. Fixed a bug where crystals were incorrectly acquired after loading a saved game.

2. Fixed the problem of reward boxes not closing when the Enter key was pressed too quickly.

3. Fixed a bug in Common Gems to ensure their healing effects work properly.

4. Fixed a bug where the extra DMG caused by Pursuit Stone was seen as True DMG.

5. Fixed the issue of obtaining the same skill upon leveling up.

notes.title: Update October 27, 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]General Game Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Optimized the in-game descriptions.

2. Enhanced Alchemist's skill - Elemental Disorder: the chance to summon a missile is now 40%.

3. Enhanced the Goldpicker Stone: Doubled the Coins gained.

4. Enhanced the Soulstealing Stone: Doubled the Essence gained.

5. Adjusted the description of Ghost's exclusive skill - Ghosty Body.

notes.title: Update October 26, 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]General Game Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Added difficulty Lv. 11 and Lv. 12.

2. Enhanced Musketeer's skill - Hype Up: Now all DMG will be enhanced.


[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

1. Fixed a bug where enemy stat boosts were not being applied in difficulty levels 9 and 12.

2. Fixed a bug that was preventing the Miasma effect from working during battles on the map.

3. Ensured that Geocore Shooter's skill "Quick Loading" functions as intended.

4. Fixed a bug where Darkblades's skill "Magic-instilled Weapon" was incorrectly treated as skill damage instead of extra damage.

5. Fixed a bug where Swashbuckler's skill "Shadow Scythe" was incorrectly classified as skill damage instead of extra damage.

notes.title: Update October 24, 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]General Game Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Shield-generating Stone: When dealing skill damage, gains a shield with its strength equal to 15% of the damage.


[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

1. Resolved an issue where the troop icon failed to appear on the map after loading a saved game.

2. Fixed a bug that allowed repeated challenges when refreshing Demon Servants rewards.

3. Fixed a bug in the Inferno Mage's skill "Pyro Enchanted" to ensure it functions as intended.

4. Fixed the problem of reward boxes not closing when the Enter key was pressed too quickly.

5. Corrected an occasional issue where an excessive number of essences were awarded.

6. Fixed a bug where "Raise Your Shield" was incorrectly treated as skill damage instead of extra damage.

7. Improved the accuracy of essence calculation in Elite and higher-level battles.

8. Fixed a bug where Overloaded failed to function as intended.

9. Fixed a bug that the Dungeons failed to generate red gems.

notes.title: Update October 23, 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]General Game Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Crystals can now be used to refresh items and characters at numerous in-game facilities.

2. Expanded the Emblem selection with 4 distinct choices.

3. Increased basic HP to improve the survival of low-HP units.


[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

1. Fixed an issue where essence rewards were incorrectly calculated in scenarios of significantly higher Battle Power than the enemies. Adjusted base coin and essence rewards accordingly.

2. Resolved the CD overflow problem in the Electro Mage's skill - Overloaded.

3. Fixed a bug concerning the Seawalker's exclusive equipment, Element Staff, causing self-infliction.

4. Fixed a bug in the Alchemist's skill Elemental Disorder, ensuring it now triggers as intended.

notes.title: Update October 20, 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]General Game Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Reduced the time consumption of all battles, especially for the common enemies.

2. Implemented a filtering feature, enabling you to select which facilities are displayed on the map.

3. Added more battle speed options, now offering three modes: Slow, Normal, and Fast.

4. Eliminated the game failure limit at Miasma level 20.

[h3]Skill Adjustments:[/h3]

1. Enhanced Imp's exclusive skill - Execute: Enemies with HP lower than 20% will now be executed.

2. Enhanced Skeleton Samurai's exclusive skill - Bushido: Increased Crit Rate from 20% to 30%.

3. Enhanced Skeleton Legionary's exclusive skill - Reshaping Body: Gains 30 extra stack(s) of Armored.

4. Enhanced Pyro Wisp's exclusive skill - Power of Flame: Normal Attack has chances to deal 100% Magic DMG.

5. Enhanced Sacrificer's exclusive skill - Soul Releasing: Increased the HP restored from 60% to 150% of their Magic Power.

6. Enhanced Berserker's skill - Lifestealing Strike: Reduced the CD from 8 to 6.

7. Enhanced Juggernaut's skill - Plate Armor Master: Increased the Defense enhancement from 30% to 40%.

8. Enhanced Juggernaut's skill - Elemental Resistance: Increased the HP restoration from 3% to 4%.

9. Enhanced Poisoner's skill - Rotting Wound: Increased the extra Physical DMG from 70% to 90%.

10. Enhanced Swashbuckler's skill - Howling Storm: Normal Attack has a 50% chance to gain 5 stack(s) of Berserked and Hasted.

11. Enhanced Inferno Mage's skill - Pyro Wisp: Raised the stats increase from 100% to 150%.

12. Enhanced Inferno Mage's skill - Pyro Enchanted: Rasied the extra Magic DMG from 30% to 40%.

13. Enhanced Electro Mage's skill - Electro Surge: Increased the probability of triggering the effect from 20% to 25%.

14. Enhanced Electro Mage's skill - Overloaded: Increased the CD speed from 5% to 7%.

15. Enhanced Support's skill - Magic Bliss: Increased the shield strength equal to that of 100% of the Magic Power.

16. Enhanced Support's skill - Healing Force: Increased the HP restoration from 150% to 170%.

17. Enhanced Shaman's skill - Transportation of Spirit: Increased the HP restoration from 70% to 100%.

18. Enhanced Tank's skill - Determination: Increased the CD deduction from 5% to 7%.

19. Enhanced Assassin's skill - Lurk in Darkness: Increased the HP restoration from 5% to 8% of HP lost per second.

20. Enhanced Darkblades's skill - Magic-instilled Weapon: Increased the extra Magic DMG from 35% to 50%.

21. Enhanced Alchemist's skill - Fair Exchange: Increased the HP restoration from 100% to 130% of Magic Power.

22. Enhanced Crossbowman's skill - Fast Shooting: Raised the Attack Speed increase from 5% to 6%.

23. Weakened Assassin's skill - Hidden Anger: Decreased the buff stacks.

24. Weakened Altai's skill - Deadly Lurker: Decreased the buff stacks.

25. Weakened Master Panda's skill - Blasting Fist: Reduced CD and True DMG.


[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

1. Fixed the bug where Battle Power failed to refresh immediately upon exiting the Troop page.

notes.title: Update October 18, 2023
notes.notes:
[b]Game Adjustments:[/b]
1. Now Demon Servants are visible on the map.
2. New button added to 'Unlock Encyclopedia' for disabling unlocked content in-game.
3. Increased your sight range by 1 tile during exploration.
4. Reduced the recovery stats of Demon Lord's special skill.
5. Reduced the time required for resting in the Village, Town, and City, as well as for completing the Dungeon.
6. Increased the earnings of Coins and Essence Challenge Tickets of the Black Market.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
1. Fixed the character info panel's HP update delay upon leveling up.
2. Fixed the flickering bug of the icons of regular combats after zooming out.

notes.title: Legendary Creatures 2 is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Really thrilled to announce that Legendary Creatures 2 is out now with a 10% launch discount!

In this sequel, open-world exploration has been integrated into a mix of roguelike and auto-battler gameplay. Embark on a brand-new adventure in the Legendary Creatures series! Gather your creatures and use their amazing powers on an epic quest to defeat the mighty demon lord.

Get a 33% total discount when you purchase the Legendary Creatures Collection BUNDLE during the first week of release. Don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35688/Legendary_Creatures_collection/


In the full game, you'll find far more creatures, facilities, emblems, items, and so much more comparing to the previous demo.
Please note that the previous demo, which is no longer indicative of the full game's quality, has been removed from Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394660/96e197a7ec854b3018195e1d8be338afe41f12d3.png[/img]

And that's not all! I've got some exciting free updates in the pipeline as well, including a special [b]challenge mode[/b] and [b]modding support[/b]. Stay tuned for more details!

Thank you for your ongoing support. Can't wait to see you in this legendary world!

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/89XMkfYt2N

notes.title: Legendary Creatures 2 Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h3]We are very happy to announce that Legendary Creatures 2 releases officially on October 17th, with a 10% launch discount for the first week![/h3]

Don't miss out if you are into exploration, strategies, rogue-lite and auto-battler!

And also, here's an awesome opportunity to try out our new demo during Steam Next Fest. New updates as follows:
- Added 6 new Creatures
- Added lots of new skills
- Available in-game days extended to 15
- Rebalanced the game stats and optimized part of the game operations
- The Crystals you collect in the new demo will be inherited to the full version. These could be used to unlock new Creatures, Emblems, Items etc. in the full game. So prepare to get started with your journey ahead!

Let's explore this legendary world together! 

Join our Discord if you have any suggestions or feedback: https://discord.gg/89XMkfYt2N
